project_type: Spring Boot 4.0.2 / Java 17 backend + Angular 20 standalone-component frontend, served separately
build_system: Maven (backend: mvn compile / mvn test); Angular CLI 20 (frontend: ng build, ng serve). Frontend package.json build script runs node scripts/generate-env.js before ng build.
test_framework: JUnit 5 / Spring Boot Test (backend); Karma + Jasmine (frontend, ng test)
build_command: Backend: cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\backend && mvn compile -q. Frontend: cd c:\Users\PC\ShuleConnect\frontend\learnplay && ng build
test_command: Backend: mvn test -pl . (from backend dir). Frontend: ng test --watch=false
verification_instructions: 1. Backend compile: cd backend && mvn compile — must produce BUILD SUCCESS with no errors. 2. Start backend (mvn spring-boot:run) and curl the new endpoints to confirm HTTP 200. 3. Frontend build: cd frontend/learnplay && ng build — must complete with no TypeScript errors. 4. Start frontend (ng serve) and navigate to /courses/notifications to confirm the page loads.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/learnplay/src/environments/environment.ts is generated at build time by scripts/generate-env.js but already exists in-repo for local dev; do not delete it.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine. Backend runs on port 8112 (/api context path). Frontend dev server on default :4200. Africa's Talking sandbox API key is in application.yaml. All backend routes except /auth/**, /public/**, /h2-console/** require JWT authentication (cookie-based, withCredentials: true on frontend).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing patterns: Lombok @Data/@Builder on DTOs, @RequiredArgsConstructor on services/controllers, @Slf4j for logging, @Async("asyncTaskExecutor") on SMS dispatch methods, standalone: true on Angular components, Tailwind CSS utility classes with font-[Fredoka], dark-green gradient bg (from-[#166534] to-[#14532d]).
key_patterns: Backend: Controllers use @RestController + @RequestMapping, inject service via @RequiredArgsConstructor, return ResponseEntity<?>. Services use @Service + @RequiredArgsConstructor + @Slf4j. DTOs live in com.softkit.wazi.model, extend BaseDto only when id/createdAt are needed (plain @Data classes otherwise). ATService.sendBulkSms(List<String>, String) is the right method for multi-recipient SMS; ATService.sendSms(String, String) for single. StringUtils.isDevMode() guard used in every ATService method. Frontend: All components are standalone (imports: [CommonModule, ...]), use templateUrl + styleUrls pattern (separate .html / .css files), inject services via constructor, use environment.apiUrl for API base URL with withCredentials: true on HttpClient options. Routing: teacher-routing-module.ts adds children under the TeacherLayout guard path. Sidebar: sidebar.html holds nav buttons; new items go inside <nav class='flex flex-col gap-1 px-2 flex-1'> BEFORE the </nav> closing tag, following the existing button pattern (bg active check via isActive(), navigate() helper).
directory_structure: backend/src/main/java/com/softkit/wazi/{controller,service,repository,model,entities,security,util} — standard Spring layered layout. frontend/learnplay/src/app/teacher/{components/{sidebar,analytics,notification,...},services,profile} — Angular feature-module layout, all components standalone.
